clips.title: The story
paras: At Balnir Farmstead, Holland's altered doom weed now draws the Scourge. The crop has become a new specimen called tomb weed, and Holland wants it for his experiments.

Junior Apothecary Holland wants more than a place among the Royal Apothecary Society. He gathers doom weed, makes small alchemical changes, and replants it in the soil of Balnir Farmstead. There, he has cultivated a new strain he calls tomb weed. Holland sees the hybrid as the heart of his work and a sign of the future he seeks for himself.

Holland expected his altered plants to gain alchemical potency, but the Scourge wandering Balnir Farmstead have taken an unexpected interest in them. He now depends on travelers to push past the undead and gather the mature crop, so his experiments can continue.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.
Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... Drawn... To the weed. Curious.

clips.title: Progress
paras: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!
A great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.
